exposure: U-shaped myometrial excavation and modified suture approach with uterus preservation
cohort: 198 patients diagnosed with diffuse adenomyosis who underwent a new surgical procedure.
finding: The new surgical method of U-shaped myometrial excavation and modified suture approach significantly decreased dysmenorrhea, menstrual blood volume, serum CA 125 level, and uterine size postoperatively, demonstrating favorable outcomes with few complications.
